definition: move door or lid so it is not closed
sentence: Turn the doorknob to open the bedroom door.

definition: shut door or lid so space is sealed
sentence: Close the door quietly when you step outside.

definition: apply force to move object away
sentence: Push the shopping cart down the grocery aisle.

definition: apply force to draw object toward oneself
sentence: Pull the rolling luggage along behind you.

definition: raise object upward to higher position
sentence: Bend your knees properly when you lift a heavy crate.

definition: support and move object while walking
sentence: He carried the package all the way to the postal office.

definition: grasp and support with hand
sentence: Hold the hot coffee mug carefully by its ceramic handle.

definition: lift object from ground or surface
sentence: Pick up the red ball that dropped on the floor.

definition: set object onto floor or table
sentence: Put down the fragile vase gently on the table.

definition: let object fall to ground by accident
sentence: Oops, be careful not to drop the ball!

definition: propel object forcefully through air
sentence: Throw the ball to me across the field.

definition: intercept and hold flying object
sentence: Extend both hands to catch the flying baseball.

definition: strike forcefully with foot
sentence: Kick the soccer ball right into the goal net.

definition: strike with bat, fist, or object
sentence: Hit the baseball hard with the wooden bat.

definition: come into physical contact with finger
sentence: Touch the mug lightly to check if it is still too hot.

definition: direct finger toward an object
sentence: Point your finger toward the red mug on the table.

definition: push firmly against a button or surface
sentence: Press the red button to ring the front door bell.

definition: rotate or twist knob with hand
sentence: Turn the golden door knob clockwise to unlatch.

definition: press firmly between fingers or hands
sentence: Squeeze the wet sponge firmly to wring out excess water.

definition: move back and forth rapidly
sentence: Shake the juice bottle well before opening the cap.

definition: put something with something already there
sentence: Add an apple to the bowl.

definition: take something away from a place
sentence: Remove the lid carefully.

definition: put something over something else
sentence: Cover the bowl with a lid.
additionalExamples: The bowl is covered with a lid.

definition: fasten one thing to another
sentence: Attach the label to the bag.

definition: join things using glue or a sticky surface
sentence: Stick the picture on the card.

definition: accidentally let liquid fall out of a container
sentence: Do not spill the water.

definition: damage something with fire or strong heat
sentence: The toast can burn.

definition: change from solid to liquid because of heat
sentence: The ice begins to melt.

definition: change from liquid to solid because of cold
sentence: Water can freeze.

definition: stay on the surface of a liquid
sentence: The toy boat floats.

definition: go down below the surface of a liquid
sentence: The stone sinks.

definition: move continuously, as a liquid does
sentence: Water flows down the stream.

definition: become larger or develop over time
sentence: The plant grows in the garden.

definition: damage something so it separates or stops working
sentence: Be careful not to break the cup.

definition: make something broken work again
sentence: He repairs the chair.

definition: become visible or come into view
sentence: A toy appears behind the curtain.

definition: put colour on a surface or make a picture with it
sentence: We paint the wall blue.

definition: move something to a higher position
sentence: Raise your hand if you have a question.

definition: move something to a lower position
sentence: Please lower the shelf a little.
